title: Backjump over unused splits in propositional Lean proofs
summary: The propositional prover in the Lean reconstructor now drops case splits whose branches do not use their hypothesis (backjumping) and keeps only the proof steps it uses. The QF_IDL circuit ckt_PROP1_tf_10 now verifies in Lean, and BubbleSort, MinMax and parity check several times faster.
